title: Find the biggest folders inside a directory
summary: List the folders inside a directory with their total sizes, sort them from largest to smallest, and show the top few. Use it when a disk is full and you need to see what takes the space.

aliases.text: what folder takes the most space linux
which folder is using all my disk space
какие папки занимают больше всего места
что занимает место на диске linux

steps.explain: du -h prints the size of each item inside DIR in human units (K, M, G). --max-depth=1 stops at the first level. 2>/dev/null hides messages about folders you cannot read. sort -rh sorts the sizes largest first and head keeps the top lines.
steps.expect: Lines such as 2.9M  data/projects/app, largest first. The line for DIR itself shows the total of everything inside it.

steps.explain: Look inside the biggest sub-folder with the same command. Replace SUBDIR with a path from the previous list.
steps.expect: The same kind of list, one level deeper.

placeholders.name: SUBDIR
placeholders.description: A folder from the previous list

warnings: du reads every file in the folder, so on a big disk it can take several minutes.
